blocks.text: Roles determine the sets of tasks that users can perform across the 3rd-Party App Governance Admin Portal based on the permissions.
Roles provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure role-based access control by assigning predefined roles to users in your organization.
Control user access to different modules.

blocks.text: 3rd-Party App Governance provides the following set of predefined roles and permissions that can be assigned to users:

blocks.item: Admin: The default super admin role with the highest level of privilege that has full access across the platform, including user management, policy editing, integrations, and security actions.
User: The user can perform key operational actions like editing policies, uploading apps, exporting data, and acknowledging findings, but cannot manage platform-wide settings or integrations.
Viewer: The user can view data across the platform and export reports, but cannot take any action or make changes.

blocks.text: To manage role assignments, contact Zscaler Support.
